executiveSummary: North Carolina Ports reported a confirmed cyberattack that caused systems-wide outages and disrupted gate and cargo operations across multiple facilities, creating immediate logistics impacts in the U.S. South Atlantic region. View Article

keyFindings: Confirmed port cyberattack disrupted IT operations and slowed gates at North Carolina Ports (Wilmington, Morehead City, Charlotte Inland Port); supply-chain impact confirmed. View Article
